t: Compass: Full dashboard with fleet status, decision queue, productivity metrics, and trends
description: Current Compass dashboard is a static HTML shell showing '0 spokes'. Now that Lathe will have data, Compass needs a real rendering engine. Create tools/compass_report.py that: (1) reads Lathe spoke_lathe.json for strategic data, (2) reads Gardener scan_state.json + reports/ for fleet health, (3) reads spoke changelogs for productivity, (4) reads taste.user.yaml for tone, (5) generates a dynamic HTML dashboard with sections: fleet overview, attention priorities, decision queue (lugs needing go/no-go), productivity trends, cost tracking.
perceive: Read existing dashboard HTML to understand current structure. Read Compass scan_state.json for data source list. Read Gardener report format. Read Lathe spoke_lathe.json (now populated). Read taste.user.yaml for personalization.
execute: Create tools/compass_report.py: (1) data layer: load all advisor state files, (2) compute metrics: lugs completed/week, teachings adopted/week, cost/spoke from gardener passes, (3) decision queue: scan all spoke open lugs tagged 'needs-decision' or with impact >= 8, (4) trend calculation: compare last 7 gardener passes for health trend per spoke, (5) HTML generation: responsive dashboard with fleet grid, attention list (top 5 by Lathe urgency), decision cards, productivity chart data, (6) write to reports/dashboard-YYYY-MM-DD.html, (7) update scan_state.json. Also create a /wai-compass command stub in hub commands.
verify: Run python3 tools/compass_report.py — generates HTML with real data. Open in browser, verify all sections populated. Verify scan_state updated.
acceptance_criteria: tools/compass_report.py generates dashboard HTML with real data
Dashboard shows: fleet status (17 spokes with health), attention priorities (sorted by Lathe urgency), decision queue, productivity metrics
Runs idempotently — can be called by gardener nightly
Dashboard subtitle shows actual spoke count, not '0 spokes'
